text:
kevin: Heads-up — Angels Edge (seed marketplace startup) asking for a trial credit bump. They burned the starter credits in a smoke test and want to run a 3-week POC with real buyer queries. Asking for an additional $7k in credits (≈200k tokens) so they can validate latency and routing.

maria: Can you drop the POC acceptance criteria and expected token/day? Need to map to our startup program tiers.

kevin: POC goals: 1) 99th p95 latency < 350ms for 1k qps spikes, 2) end-to-end integration with embeddings + chat, 3) token quality checks vs current vendor. Expect ~70k tokens/week, peak days 30k. No immediate ARR commit — they’re in YC S21.

omar: Quick Q — are they asking for hosted credits only or do they need a Dedicated demo?

kevin: Hosted API credits only. However, they flagged a security blocker — their security lead wants a VPC/network isolation checklist before they run anything production-like.

nina: On the security side: for a demo we can share a SOC2 summary and run an abbreviated questionnaire. If they require VPC, that moves it to Private/Dedicated — that's not part of a free credit play. We can offer an isolated sandbox with IP allowlist + ephemeral keys.

maria: For the startup program, standard is $3k credit for YC/similar. Asking for $7k is an exception. If no ARR/commit, deal-desk signoff required.

kevin: Can we get an exception? Their product team is strategic for marketplace integrations — low ARR today but high potential. Also they'd sign a short case study if POC succeeds.

omar: Case study + YC batch helps. Deal-desk: what’s the exception playbook?

deal-desk: Proposal: approve a one-time $5k hosted credit plus a conversion offer — if they convert to a paid reserved pool within 60 days, apply a 20% credit match (up to $10k) toward the first invoice. Require a one-page MOU and standard trial T&Cs.

kevin: Sounds reasonable. Can we add the IP allowlist sandbox option so security is happy?

nina: Yes — provide ephemeral sandbox keys and a hard expiry. We'll also send the abbreviated questionnaire and SOC2 extract. If they demand VPC, we escalate to Sales Eng and Ops for a Private trial quote.

susan: I can provision the sandbox. Quick snippet to share with Angels Edge: ```bash
# set API key
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=redwood-test-xxxx
# quick embeddings call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["sample query"]}'
```
Will rotate keys automatically at expiry.

maria: Deal-desk — are you OK with $5k + conversion incentive? Need legal to pre-approve MOU template. Also update the startup program sheet.

deal-desk: Yes, approve $5k. Condition: trial used within 30 days and no VPC requirement. If they ask for VPC, offer Private pilot pricing instead (no free credits, but discounted reserved rate). Legal — please review fixed MOU template in #legal-review.

kevin: Will share the sandbox details with Angels Edge and ask them to complete the questionnaire. I’ll push for the case study clause.

maria: I'll log the exception in the pricing tracker and flag the account for follow-up. CRM note: "Trial Exception: $5k credit, 20% conversion match, sandbox IP allowlist, SOC2 extract shared."

kevin: Thanks all :rocket:

susan: Provisioned the sandbox and uploaded credentials to the secure share. Sent link to Kevin. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Angels Edge replied — they accepted the sandbox plan and will sign the MOU. Asking if we can extend trial window to 45 days given calendar constraints.

deal-desk: We can allow 45 days as a one-time accommodation — update the MOU.

maria: Noted, updated tracker. Closing loop once MOU signed and keys used.

kevin: Closing — will post final status in CRM and ping if any security escalation. Thanks everyone! :pray:
